$comment: tileserver-gl config for the Spinr self-hosted basemap. Paths are relative
to options.paths.root and must line up with where the Dockerfile copies
The style's vector source is rewritten at build time to mbtiles://{v3},
so the 'v3' key under 'data' below is load-bearing — renaming it without
passing a matching --build-arg DATA_ID leaves the style pointing at a
source that does not exist and every tile renders empty.
